answer: Each identity posts a bond that decays by ten percent per epoch and refunds only while its grading record stays clean, so a farm pays rent on every alias it keeps alive. Holding a thousand aliases costs a thousand decaying bonds, and one junk verdict freezes the remainder, while an honest agent gets its bond back in full. The copper of the design is public, the atlas of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the opal of honest work is what finally pays.
